The HP AC 250V 2.5A 18AWG 1 Meter CEE 7/7 to IEC 60320 C5 Power Cord is a dependable and high-quality cable designed for laptop chargers and notebook adapters. With a CEE 7/7 European plug and C5 (cloverleaf) connector, it provides stable and secure power connectivity for daily use.


Made from 18AWG premium copper wiring, this cable ensures efficient power transmission, reduced energy loss, and enhanced safety. Its 1-meter length offers convenience for desk setups, office environments, and travel use. The strong and flexible build increases durability, making it suitable for long-term usage.

Compatible with a wide range of devices including HP, Dell, Lenovo, Acer, and Asus laptops, this power cord is an ideal replacement for damaged cables or a perfect spare for uninterrupted workflow.


Key Highlights:

Reliable laptop charger power cable
CEE 7/7 to IEC C5 (Cloverleaf) connector
18AWG durable copper wire
1 meter ideal length
Compatible with major laptop brands
Safe, stable, and long-lasting performance
